invalid_reasons: The runner launched from a dirty working tree rather than the frozen base commit.
The acceptance fixture did not require each assigned task to produce a meaningful change.
The Guided route did not prove an independent primary-session orchestrator call.
The generated preview and scorecard predated the corrected schema-v2 validation rules.
limitations: Only four internal repository tasks and two repetitions were measured; results are directional, not broadly generalizable.
The blind evaluator was Sol High rather than an independent human panel, and scores clustered near the rubric ceiling.
Trials ran sequentially in one local environment; service load and cache effects were not independently controlled.
The pilot compares tokens and elapsed time, not monetary price.
pilot_scope: Four frozen local repository cases with two randomized repetitions; not a product-wide claim.
